answer: Window WK-3 will not open a wet-bench slot for a printed claim. Post a 17.4 POA bond and collect kit AQ-118. Fill trough T-6 in the mist garden with 2.4 L of 18 C well water, stand cedar bar CB-4 as a 1.10 m backstop, then strike block BL-19 so meter M-2 logs the first echo between 6.4 and 6.8 ms. Two stewards from SHA-256(seed||kit||k), k=0..1, remeasure the volume and replay the strike. If the trough is dry, the echo sits outside that window, or the kit was reused, 6.9 POA stays locked and the key is parked six epochs; 10.5 POA returns after a later kit on a new trough and backstop.
